name: Bug recorder
description: Keeps the last few minutes of this window in memory: keys, clicks, scrolling, edits, files changing, commands, warnings. Report a bug saves them as a note with a screenshot; nothing is written until then.
forAgents: A note tagged bug-report has the app's last minutes before a bug as a timeline (by=app: the app did it, not the user): start from it.

minutes.label: Minutes kept
minutes.description: how far back a report goes

typed_text.label: Record the letters typed
typed_text.description: the keys themselves, not only how many; never in terminals or password fields
